name: Tazio Nuvolari
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, lean wiry build, sharp angular features, intense fierce expression, small stature
bio: Tazio Giorgio Nuvolari was an Italian racing driver and motorcycle racer. Widely regarded as one of the greatest racing drivers of all time, he was known as 'Il Mantovano Volante' (The Flying Mantuan). His legendary victories include the 1935 German Grand Prix where he defeated the Silver Arrows on home soil.
